requirement: The Central Government shall be informed of any defect in the appointment of a person acting as the Chairperson or other Member of the Board.
checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government is informed of any defect in the appointment of the Chairperson or Members.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the appointment process of the Board members.

requirement: The Board may appoint officers and employees as necessary for the efficient discharge of its functions, with prior approval from the Central Government.
checkable_test: Verify if the Board has the authority to appoint officers and employees with prior Central Government approval.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement allows the Board to function efficiently by appointing necessary personnel.

requirement: The Central Government may specify an Examiner of Electronic Evidence to provide expert opinion on electronic form evidence.
checkable_test: Check if the organization has procedures for handling electronic evidence in accordance with the law.
applicability: Applies to organizations handling electronic evidence.
notes: This obligation relates to the handling and verification of electronic evidence.

requirement: The Central Government may enter public places and search or arrest individuals suspected of committing offenses under the IT Act without a warrant.
checkable_test: Verify if the organization has procedures for cooperating with law enforcement in public places.
applicability: Applies to intermediaries and entities handling electronic communications.
notes: This obligation outlines the government's authority to conduct searches and arrests in public places.

requirement: Notifications made by the Central Government under Section 82 must be laid before Parliament for review and potential modification or annulment.
checkable_test: Check if the organization has procedures for handling notifications from the Central Government under Section 82.
applicability: Applies to intermediaries and entities handling electronic communications.
notes: This obligation outlines the procedural requirements for notifications under the IT Act.

requirement: No legal action can be taken against the Central Government, State Government, or persons acting on their behalf for actions taken in good faith under the IT Act.
checkable_test: Verify if the organization has procedures to ensure actions are taken in good faith under the IT Act.
applicability: Applies to intermediaries and entities handling electronic communications.
notes: This obligation protects entities acting in good faith under the IT Act.

requirement: Failure to respond within the specified period is deemed a refusal of the request.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform treats delayed responses as refusals.
applicability: Applicable to public authorities handling information requests.
notes: This obligation applies to the consequences of not responding within the time limit.

requirement: The Central Government may issue a licence to a service provider if no recommendations are received from the Authority within the specified period.
source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government issues a licence when no recommendations are received within the time limit.
applicability: Applicable when the Authority fails to provide recommendations within the time limit.
notes: This clause outlines the licensing authority of the Central Government in the absence of recommendations.

requirement: The Authority may notify rates for telecommunication services in India and outside India in the Official Gazette.
source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
checkable_test: Check if the Authority publishes rates for telecommunication services in the Official Gazette.
applicability: Applicable when the Authority sets rates for telecommunication services.
notes: This clause outlines the Authority's power to set and notify service rates.

requirement: The Central Government or a State Government or a local authority or any person aggrieved by any direction, decision or order made by the Authority may prefer an appeal to the Appellate Tribunal.
checkable_test: Check if the document allows for appeals to the Appellate Tribunal by the Central Government, State Government, local authority, or aggrieved person.
applicability: Applicable to any document that outlines appeal mechanisms under TRAI Act 1997.
notes: This clause establishes the right to appeal to the Appellate Tribunal.

requirement: Every appeal under sub-section (2) shall be preferred within a period of thirty days from the date on which a copy of the direction or order or decision made by the Authority is received by the Central Government or the State Government or the local authority or the aggrieved person.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a 30-day deadline for filing appeals.
applicability: Applicable to any document that outlines appeal mechanisms under TRAI Act 1997.
notes: This clause sets a time limit for filing appeals.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal shall consist of a Chairperson and not more than two Members to be appointed, by notification, by the Central Government.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the composition of the Appellate Tribunal as a Chairperson and up to two Members.
applicability: Applicable to any document that outlines the structure of the Appellate Tribunal under TRAI Act 1997.
notes: This clause defines the composition of the Appellate Tribunal.

requirement: In the case of a Member, has held the post of Secretary to the Government of India or any equivalent post in the Central Government or the State Government for a period of not less than two years or a person who is well versed in the field of technology, telecommunication, industry, commerce or administration.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that a Member of the Appellate Tribunal must have held a relevant government post for at least two years or have expertise in technology, telecommunication, industry, commerce, or administration.
applicability: Applicable to any document that outlines the qualifications for Appellate Tribunal Members under TRAI Act 1997.
notes: This clause outlines the qualifications for Appellate Tribunal Members.

requirement: If, for reason other than temporary absence, any vacancy occurs in the office of the Chairperson or a Member of the Appellate Tribunal, the Central Government shall appoint another person in accordance with the provisions of this Act to fill the vacancy and the proceedings may be continued before the Appellate Tribunal from the stage at which the vacancy is filled.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that the Central Government must appoint a replacement for a vacancy in the Appellate Tribunal and continue proceedings from the stage of the vacancy.
applicability: Applicable to any document that outlines the appointment process for Appellate Tribunal vacancies under TRAI Act 1997.
notes: This clause outlines the process for filling vacancies in the Appellate Tribunal.

requirement: The Authority shall determine the tariff once in five years and may amend it from time to time during the said period of five years if considered appropriate and in public interest.
source: AERA_ACT_2008, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
checkable_test: Check if the Authority determines tariffs every five years and has the power to amend them during the period.
applicability: Applicable to major airports under the AERA Act 2008.
notes: This obligation relates to the Authority's responsibility to set and adjust tariffs in accordance with the Act.

requirement: The Authority may appoint persons to inquire into the affairs of service providers and direct its officers to inspect their documents.
checkable_test: Whether the Authority has the power to appoint persons to inquire into service providers' affairs and direct inspections.
applicability: Applicable to service providers subject to the AERA Act 2008.
notes: This clause outlines the Authority's investigative powers, which may be relevant to platform liability in regulatory contexts.

requirement: An aggrieved party may file an appeal with the Appellate Tribunal within thirty days of receiving a direction, decision, or order from the Authority.
checkable_test: Verify the existence of a time-bound appeal mechanism within thirty days for appeals to the Appellate Tribunal.
applicability: Applies to appeals by the Central Government, State Government, local authority, or aggrieved person.
notes: This clause outlines the procedural requirement for filing an appeal within thirty days.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must send a copy of every order made by it to the parties to the dispute or the appeal and to the Authority.
checkable_test: Verify that the Appellate Tribunal provides copies of its orders to all relevant parties and the Authority.
applicability: Applies to all orders made by the Appellate Tribunal.
notes: This clause mandates the dissemination of orders to all affected parties and the Authority.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must record its reasons in writing for not disposing of an application or appeal within ninety days.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal provides written reasons for delays in disposing of applications or appeals beyond ninety days.
applicability: Applicable to cases where the Appellate Tribunal fails to dispose of an application or appeal within ninety days.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the procedural obligation of the Appellate Tribunal to provide written reasons for delays.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must consist of a Chairperson and not more than two Members appointed by the Central Government.
checkable_test: Verify that the Appellate Tribunal is composed of a Chairperson and not more than two Members appointed by the Central Government.
applicability: Applicable to the composition of the Appellate Tribunal.
notes: This requirement defines the structure and appointment process of the Appellate Tribunal.

requirement: The Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal must be appointed in consultation with the Chief Justice of India or his nominee.
checkable_test: Confirm that the Central Government consults the Chief Justice of India or his nominee when appointing the Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal.
applicability: Applicable to the appointment process of the Appellate Tribunal.
notes: This requirement outlines the consultation process for appointments.

requirement: The Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal must meet specific qualifications for appointment.
checkable_test: Verify that the qualifications for appointment as Chairperson or Member of the Appellate Tribunal are met.
applicability: Applicable to the appointment of the Appellate Tribunal.
notes: This requirement outlines the qualifications for appointment to the Appellate Tribunal.

requirement: The Chairperson of the Appellate Tribunal must retire upon reaching the age of seventy years.
checkable_test: Check if the Chairperson of the Appellate Tribunal retires upon reaching the age of seventy years.
applicability: Applicable to the retirement age of the Chairperson of the Appellate Tribunal.
notes: This requirement sets the retirement age for the Chairperson of the Appellate Tribunal.

requirement: Other Members of the Appellate Tribunal must retire upon reaching the age of sixty-five years.
checkable_test: Verify that other Members of the Appellate Tribunal retire upon reaching the age of sixty-five years.
applicability: Applicable to the retirement age of other Members of the Appellate Tribunal.
notes: This requirement sets the retirement age for other Members of the Appellate Tribunal.

requirement: The salary, allowances, and terms of service of the Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal cannot be varied to their disadvantage after appointment.
checkable_test: Confirm that the salary, allowances, and terms of service of the Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal cannot be varied to their disadvantage after appointment.
applicability: Applicable to the terms of service of the Appellate Tribunal members.
notes: This requirement ensures that the terms of service of the Appellate Tribunal members are protected after appointment.

requirement: The Board must provide reasons for its actions during the course of an inquiry.
checkable_test: Whether the Board provides reasons for its actions during the course of an inquiry.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to record reasons for actions during an inquiry.

requirement: The Board may issue interim orders during an inquiry, after giving the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
checkable_test: Whether the Board issues interim orders during an inquiry after providing the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to issue interim orders after providing an opportunity of being heard.

requirement: The Board may close proceedings or proceed under section 33 after giving the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
checkable_test: Check if the Board provides an opportunity for the person concerned to be heard before closing proceedings or proceeding under section 33.
applicability: Applicable to complaints under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause outlines the procedural requirement for the Board to provide an opportunity for the person concerned to be heard before taking action.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal shall record its reasons in writing for not disposing of an appeal within six months.
checkable_test: Verify if the Appellate Tribunal records its reasons in writing for not disposing of an appeal within six months.
applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause mandates the Appellate Tribunal to record reasons for delays in disposing of appeals.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal shall deal with an appeal under this section in accordance with such procedure as may be prescribed.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal follows prescribed procedures for handling appeals under this section.
applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause requires the Appellate Tribunal to follow prescribed procedures for handling appeals.

requirement: The provisions of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 shall apply.
checkable_test: Verify if the provisions of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 apply to appeals under this section.
applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause mandates the application of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: An order passed by the Appellate Tribunal under this Act shall be executable by it as a decree of civil court.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal's order is executable as a decree of civil court.
applicability: Applicable to orders passed by the Appellate Tribunal under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause establishes the executability of the Appellate Tribunal's orders as decrees of civil court.

requirement: Penalties imposed by the Board under the Act must be credited to the Consolidated Fund of India.
checkable_test: Verify if penalties imposed by the Board are credited to the Consolidated Fund of India.
applicability: Applicable to all penalties imposed by the Board under the Act.
notes: This obligation outlines the financial handling of penalties imposed by the Board under the Act.

requirement: No legal proceedings may be initiated against the Central Government, the Board, its Chairperson, or its Members, officers, or employees for actions taken in good faith under the Act or its rules.
checkable_test: Check if legal proceedings have been initiated against the Central Government, the Board, or its officials for actions taken in good faith under the Act.
applicability: Applicable to the Central Government, the Board, its Chairperson, and its Members, officers, or employees.
notes: This obligation protects the Central Government and the Board from legal action for actions taken in good faith under the Act.

requirement: The Central Government or its authorized officers may take action upon a written reference from the Board regarding specific matters under the Act.
checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government or its authorized officers have taken action based on a written reference from the Board.
applicability: Applicable to the Central Government and its authorized officers when receiving a reference from the Board.
notes: This obligation outlines the Central Government's authority to act on references from the Board under the Act.

requirement: Intermediaries must comply with directions issued by the Central Board under the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Verify if the intermediary is required to comply with directions issued by the Central Board.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause mandates compliance with directions issued by the Central Board by intermediaries.

requirement: The reference to any subsidy, benefit, service, certificate, licence or permit provided or issued using public funds shall be construed as a reference to provision or issuance of such subsidy, benefit, service, certificate, licence or permit by incurring expenditure on the same from, or with accrual of receipts to, public funds.
checkable_test: Existence of a definition for references to subsidies, benefits, etc. provided using public funds.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement defines the scope of references to subsidies, benefits, etc. provided using public funds.

requirement: Electronic signatures must be uniquely linked to the signatory and under their exclusive control.
checkable_test: Verify that the electronic signature is uniquely linked to the signatory and under their exclusive control.
applicability: Applicable to all electronic signatures used in legal documents.
notes: This requirement ensures that electronic signatures are not misused or impersonated.

requirement: Electronic signatures must be under the exclusive control of the signatory at the time of signing.
checkable_test: Verify that the electronic signature was under the exclusive control of the signatory at the time of signing.
applicability: Applicable to all electronic signatures used in legal documents.
notes: This requirement ensures that electronic signatures are not forged or misused.

requirement: Any alteration to an electronically signed document must be detectable.
checkable_test: Verify that any alteration to an electronically signed document is detectable.
applicability: Applicable to all electronically signed documents.
notes: This requirement ensures the integrity of electronically signed documents.

requirement: The Central Government may establish procedures to verify the authenticity of electronic signatures.
checkable_test: Verify that the Central Government has established procedures to verify the authenticity of electronic signatures.
applicability: Applicable to all electronic signatures used in legal documents.
notes: This requirement ensures that electronic signatures can be verified by authorized authorities.

requirement: The Central Government may add or remove electronic signature techniques from the Second Schedule.
checkable_test: Verify that the Central Government has the authority to add or remove electronic signature techniques from the Second Schedule.
applicability: Applicable to all electronic signature techniques used in legal documents.
notes: This requirement allows for the updating of electronic signature standards by the Central Government.

requirement: Electronic records must be usable in place of traditional written forms.
checkable_test: Verify that electronic records are usable in place of traditional written forms.
applicability: Applicable to all electronic records used in legal documents.
notes: This requirement ensures that electronic records are legally recognized as valid substitutes for traditional written forms.

requirement: A body corporate's 'usual place of residence' is defined as the place where it is registered.
checkable_test: Verify if the definition of 'usual place of residence' for a body corporate is explicitly stated as the place of registration.
applicability: Applicable to all body corporates under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This clause defines the 'usual place of residence' for a body corporate as the place where it is registered, which is a checkable definition.

requirement: A Certifying Authority must comply with conditions and restrictions specified by regulations to maintain recognition under the IT Act 2000.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
checkable_test: Verify if the Certifying Authority is subject to conditions and restrictions specified by regulations.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities recognized under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation relates to the conditions and restrictions that must be followed by recognized Certifying Authorities.

requirement: A Certifying Authority must maintain compliance with the conditions and restrictions to avoid revocation of recognition.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
checkable_test: Verify if the Certifying Authority has been revoked for non-compliance with conditions and restrictions.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities recognized under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation ensures that Certifying Authorities remain compliant with the conditions and restrictions for their recognition.

requirement: A Certifying Authority must obtain prior approval from the Central Government before being recognized under the IT Act 2000.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
checkable_test: Verify if the Certifying Authority received prior approval from the Central Government for recognition.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities recognized under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation requires Certifying Authorities to obtain prior approval from the Central Government before being recognized.

requirement: A Certifying Authority must issue valid electronic signature certificates that are recognized under the IT Act 2000.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
checkable_test: Verify if the electronic signature certificate issued by the Certifying Authority is valid under the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities recognized under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation ensures that electronic signature certificates issued by Certifying Authorities are valid under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: A person seeking to issue electronic signature certificates must apply for a licence from the Controller under the IT Act 2000.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
checkable_test: Verify if the applicant has applied for a licence to issue electronic signature certificates.
applicability: Applicable to persons seeking to issue electronic signature certificates.
notes: This obligation requires applicants to obtain a licence from the Controller before issuing electronic signature certificates.

requirement: A person seeking to issue electronic signature certificates must meet prescribed requirements for qualification, expertise, and infrastructure.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
checkable_test: Verify if the applicant meets the prescribed requirements for qualification, expertise, and infrastructure.
applicability: Applicable to persons seeking to issue electronic signature certificates.
notes: This obligation ensures that only qualified and capable entities are granted the right to issue electronic signature certificates.

requirement: The Controller may delegate powers to officers under this Chapter.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
checkable_test: Check if the Controller has delegated powers to officers for executing functions under this Chapter.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This is a procedural obligation regarding the delegation of authority.

requirement: The Controller or authorised officer may investigate contraventions of the Act, rules, or regulations.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
checkable_test: Verify if the Controller or authorised officer has the authority to investigate contraventions.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation outlines the investigative powers of the Controller or authorised officers.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must ensure that all employees and engaged personnel comply with the provisions of the IT Act, 2000, rules, regulations, and orders made thereunder.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority's governance documents include a requirement for all employees and engaged personnel to comply with the IT Act, 2000, rules, regulations, and orders made thereunder.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities under the IT Act, 2000.
notes: This requirement ensures that Certifying Authorities maintain compliance with legal obligations through their workforce.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must display their licence at a conspicuous place of their premises.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority's governance documents include a requirement to display the licence at a conspicuous place of their premises.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities under the IT Act, 2000.
notes: This requirement ensures transparency and accountability by requiring the physical display of the licence.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must surrender their licence immediately upon suspension or revocation.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority's governance documents include a requirement to surrender the licence immediately upon suspension or revocation.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities under the IT Act, 2000.
notes: This requirement ensures that Certifying Authorities promptly cease operations when their licence is suspended or revoked.

requirement: Certifying Authority must communicate suspension of a Digital Signature Certificate to the subscriber.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority notifies the subscriber of the suspension of their Digital Signature Certificate.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the communication of certificate suspension.

requirement: Certifying Authority may revoke a Digital Signature Certificate under specified conditions.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority has procedures in place to revoke Digital Signature Certificates as per legal requirements.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation outlines the authority of the Certifying Authority to revoke certificates.

requirement: Certifying Authority must issue a Digital Signature Certificate upon application, subject to prescribed conditions.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority has procedures in place to issue Digital Signature Certificates upon valid application.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation outlines the duty of the Certifying Authority to issue certificates upon application.

requirement: Certifying Authority must charge a fee not exceeding twenty-five thousand rupees for the issuance of a Digital Signature Certificate.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority charges a fee not exceeding twenty-five thousand rupees for the issuance of a Digital Signature Certificate.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation sets the maximum fee for the issuance of a Digital Signature Certificate.

requirement: Certifying Authority must issue a certification practice statement or a statement containing specified particulars with the application for a Digital Signature Certificate.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority requires applicants to provide a certification practice statement or a statement containing specified particulars.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation mandates the submission of specific documentation with the application for a Digital Signature Certificate.

requirement: Certifying Authority must certify that the Digital Signature Certificate is issued in accordance with prescribed conditions.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority certifies that the Digital Signature Certificate is issued in accordance with prescribed conditions.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation ensures that the issuance of the certificate is in compliance with legal requirements.

requirement: Certifying Authority must take action if any event occurs that may materially and adversely affect the integrity of its computer system or the conditions subject to which a Digital Signature Certificate was granted.
checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority has procedures in place to address events that may adversely affect the integrity of its computer system or the conditions of a Digital Signature Certificate.
applicability: Applicable to all Certifying Authorities issuing Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation requires the Certifying Authority to act in the event of system integrity or certificate condition issues.

requirement: Subscribers must ensure all representations made to the Certifying Authority are true and accurate.
checkable_test: Verify if subscribers are required to ensure all representations made to the Certifying Authority are true.
applicability: Applies to subscribers of Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the accuracy of representations under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Intermediaries must furnish documents, returns, or reports to the Controller or Certifying Authority as required.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform has policies in place to ensure timely furnishing of required documents, returns, or reports.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries required to furnish documents, returns, or reports.
notes: This clause outlines a penalty for failure to furnish required documents, returns, or reports.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must specify the matters and places in relation to which it may exercise jurisdiction.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal's jurisdiction is clearly specified in the document.
applicability: Applicable to platforms subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the requirement that the Central Government specify the jurisdiction of the Appellate Tribunal.

requirement: Any person aggrieved by an order made by a controller or adjudicating officer may prefer an appeal to the Appellate Tribunal having jurisdiction in the matter.
checkable_test: Verify that the document allows for appeals to the Appellate Tribunal as per the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to platforms subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the right of appeal to the Appellate Tribunal under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must send a copy of every order made by it to the parties to the appeal and to the concerned Controller or adjudicating officer.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires the Appellate Tribunal to send copies of its orders to the relevant parties.
applicability: Applicable to platforms subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the requirement to send copies of orders to the parties under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must have the same powers as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, for certain matters.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the powers of the Appellate Tribunal as per the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.
applicability: Applicable to platforms subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the grant of civil court powers to the Appellate Tribunal under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: The appellant may either appear in person or authorise legal practitioners or officers to present their case before the Appellate Tribunal.
checkable_test: Verify that the document allows for legal representation before the Appellate Tribunal.
applicability: Applicable to platforms subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the right to legal representation before the Appellate Tribunal under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Intermediaries must comply with rules and regulations made under the IT Act 2000, including those related to cyber regulations.
checkable_test: Check if the intermediary has implemented compliance with rules and regulations made under the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to comply with rules and regulations made under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Intermediaries must consult with the Cyber Regulations Advisory Committee and obtain prior approval from the Central Government before making regulations under the IT Act 2000.
checkable_test: Verify if the intermediary has consulted with the Cyber Regulations Advisory Committee and obtained prior approval from the Central Government before making regulations.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to consult with the Cyber Regulations Advisory Committee and obtain prior approval from the Central Government.

requirement: Intermediaries must maintain records of Certifying Authority disclosures as specified in section 18(1)(n) of the IT Act 2000.
checkable_test: Check if the document contains records of Certifying Authority disclosures as required by section 18(1)(n) of the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries handling Certifying Authority disclosures.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to maintain records under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Intermediaries must specify conditions and restrictions for recognizing foreign Certifying Authorities under section 19(1) of the IT Act 2000.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies conditions and restrictions for recognizing foreign Certifying Authorities as required by section 19(1) of the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries recognizing foreign Certifying Authorities.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to specify conditions and restrictions under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Intermediaries must observe other standards set for Certifying Authorities under section 30(d) of the IT Act 2000.
checkable_test: Check if the document observes other standards set for Certifying Authorities as required by section 30(d) of the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries subject to standards for Certifying Authorities.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to observe other standards under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Intermediaries must specify the manner of disclosure by Certifying Authorities under section 34(1) of the IT Act 2000.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the manner of disclosure by Certifying Authorities as required by section 34(1) of the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries handling disclosures by Certifying Authorities.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to specify the manner of disclosure under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Intermediaries must specify the particulars of statements accompanying applications under section 35(3) of the IT Act 2000.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the particulars of statements accompanying applications as required by section 35(3) of the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries handling applications under section 35.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to specify the particulars of statements under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Intermediaries must specify the manner of communication of private key compromise to Certifying Authorities under section 42(2) of the IT Act 2000.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the manner of communication of private key compromise to Certifying Authorities as required by section 42(2) of the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries handling private key compromise notifications.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to specify the manner of communication under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Public authorities must publish all relevant facts while formulating important policies or announcing decisions that affect the public.
checkable_test: Verify if the public authority has published all relevant facts for policies or decisions affecting the public.
applicability: Applicable to all public authorities formulating policies or making decisions affecting the public.
notes: This obligation requires transparency in policy-making and decision-making processes.

requirement: Public authorities must provide reasons for their administrative or quasi-judicial decisions to affected persons.
checkable_test: Verify if the public authority has provided reasons for administrative or quasi-judicial decisions to affected persons.
applicability: Applicable to all administrative or quasi-judicial decisions affecting individuals.
notes: This obligation ensures transparency and accountability in decision-making processes.

requirement: Public authorities must take necessary steps to ensure compliance with the RTI Act, including making changes to their record-keeping and management practices.
checkable_test: Check if the public authority has implemented changes to its record-keeping, management, and destruction practices as required by the RTI Act.
applicability: Applicable to public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement to modify practices related to record management.

requirement: No legal action can be taken against individuals acting in good faith under the RTI Act or its rules.
checkable_test: Confirm that no legal action is being taken against individuals who acted in good faith under the RTI Act.
applicability: Applicable to individuals and public authorities acting under the RTI Act 2005.
notes: This provision protects individuals who act in good faith when fulfilling obligations under the RTI Act.

requirement: Public authorities must include details of the number of requests made to each public authority in their annual reports.
checkable_test: Verify that the annual report includes the number of requests made to each public authority as specified in Section 25(3)(a) of the RTI Act 2005.
applicability: Applicable to all public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under Section 25(3)(a) of the RTI Act 2005.

requirement: Public authorities must provide recommendations for reform, including specific suggestions for improving or amending the RTI Act or related legislation.
checkable_test: A public authority must publish reform recommendations for the RTI Act or related laws.
applicability: Public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005
notes: This obligation promotes continuous improvement and reform of the RTI framework.

requirement: The appropriate Government must lay before Parliament or State Legislatures the recommendations of the Commission for reform, including specific suggestions for improving or amending the RTI Act or related legislation.
checkable_test: The appropriate Government must submit reform recommendations to Parliament or State Legislatures.
applicability: Appropriate Government under the RTI Act 2005
notes: This obligation ensures that reform recommendations are formally considered by legislative bodies.

requirement: The Authority must ensure that all decisions are fully documented and explained.
source: AERA_ACT_2008, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY (c)
checkable_test: Check if all decisions of the Authority are fully documented and explained in the governance documents.
applicability: Applicable to all decisions made by the Authority.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the transparency and accountability of the Authority's decision-making process.

requirement: The Authority Appellate Tribunal must adjudicate disputes between service providers and consumers.
source: AERA_ACT_2008, SECTION=Authority Appellate Tribunal to— (a) and (ii)
checkable_test: Verify that the Authority Appellate Tribunal is responsible for adjudicating disputes between service providers and consumers.
applicability: Applicable to disputes involving service providers and consumers.
notes: This obligation outlines the role of the Authority Appellate Tribunal in resolving disputes.

requirement: The Authority Appellate Tribunal must hear and dispose of appeals against decisions of the Authority.
checkable_test: Check if the Authority Appellate Tribunal is responsible for hearing and disposing of appeals against Authority decisions.
applicability: Applicable to all appeals against Authority decisions.
notes: This obligation ensures that there is a mechanism for appealing Authority decisions.

requirement: The Disputes Redressal Forum or Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission must dispose of applications or appeals within ninety days from the date of receipt.
checkable_test: Check if the timeline for resolving disputes is explicitly set to ninety days.
applicability: Applies to all disputes handled by the Disputes Redressal Forum or Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.
notes: This clause establishes a clear time limit for resolving disputes, which is directly checkable.

requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Appellate Tribunal must have relevant experience in aviation, economics, or law, or have served in equivalent government positions for at least two years.
checkable_test: Verify if the qualifications for the Chairperson or Members include relevant experience or government service.
applicability: Applies to the appointment of the Chairperson and Members of the Appellate Tribunal.
notes: This clause sets specific qualifications for the Appellate Tribunal members, which is directly checkable.

requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Appellate Tribunal may not hold office after they have attained the age of sixty-five.
checkable_test: Check if the age limit for the Chairperson or Members is explicitly set to sixty-five.
applicability: Applies to the term of office for the Chairperson and Members of the Appellate Tribunal.
notes: This clause establishes an age limit for the tenure of the Appellate Tribunal members, which is directly checkable.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must ensure that the salary and allowances of its Chairperson and Members are prescribed by the appropriate authority.
checkable_test: Verify if the salary and allowances for the Appellate Tribunal members are subject to prescription by an authority.
applicability: Applies to the terms and conditions of service for the Appellate Tribunal members.
notes: This clause mandates that the salary and allowances for the Appellate Tribunal members are prescribed by an authority, which is directly checkable.

requirement: The provisions of Chapter II, except sub-sections (1) and (5) of section 8, and those of Chapter III and section 16 shall not apply where—
checkable_test: Verify whether the specific provisions of the Act are excluded from application in the specified circumstances.
applicability: Applies to situations where the provisions of Chapter II and III are excluded.
notes: This clause outlines exceptions to the application of certain provisions of the Act.

requirement: Any person aggrieved by an order or direction made by the Board under this Act may prefer an appeal before the Appellate Tribunal.
checkable_test: Whether a person has the right to appeal an order or direction issued by the Board.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause establishes the right of appeal for individuals affected by decisions made by the Board.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must dispose of appeals finally within six months from the date of receipt.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal has a policy to resolve appeals within six months.
applicability: Applicable to all appeals filed under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement sets a time limit for the resolution of appeals.

requirement: The Chairperson and other Members of the Board must be appointed in the manner specified.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the manner of appointment of the Chairperson and other Members of the Board.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation relates to the appointment process of the Board members.

requirement: The terms and conditions of appointment and service of officers and employees of the Board must be specified.
checkable_test: Verify if the document outlines the terms and conditions of appointment and service of officers and employees of the Board.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation is related to the appointment and service terms of the Board officers and employees.

requirement: The document must specify any other matter which is to be or may be prescribed or in respect of which provision is to be, or may be, made by rules.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies any other matter which is to be or may be prescribed or in respect of which provision is to be, or may be, made by rules.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation is related to the specification of other matters under section 28.

requirement: Any amendment notified under sub-section (1) shall have effect as if enacted in this Act and shall come into force on the date of the notification.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that any amendment notified under sub-section (1) shall have effect as if enacted in this Act and shall come into force on the date of the notification.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation relates to the effect and implementation of amendments under section 28.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must follow specific procedures when issuing electronic signature certificates.
checkable_test: Verify if the document outlines procedures followed by Certifying Authorities when issuing electronic signature certificates.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities issuing electronic signature certificates.
notes: This requirement is derived from Section 30 of the IT Act 2000, which mandates procedural compliance.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must ensure compliance with the IT Act and related regulations.
checkable_test: Check if the document includes a statement that Certifying Authorities ensure compliance with the IT Act and related regulations.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from Section 31 of the IT Act 2000, which mandates compliance with the Act.

requirement: A system must provide a reasonable level of reliability and correct operation.
checkable_test: Verify if the system provides a reasonable level of reliability and correct operation as per the regulations.
applicability: Applicable to systems under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the definition of a 'secure system' under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: A system must be reasonably suited to performing the intended functions.
checkable_test: Verify if the system is reasonably suited to performing the intended functions as per the regulations.
applicability: Applicable to systems under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the definition of a 'secure system' under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Any alteration to an electronic signature made after affixing such signature must be detectable.
checkable_test: Verify if alterations to an electronic signature made after affixing are detectable.
applicability: Applicable to electronic signatures under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the definition of a 'secure system' under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Electronic signatures or authentication techniques must be reliable and specified in the Second Schedule of the IT Act 2000.
checkable_test: Verify whether the Second Schedule of the IT Act 2000 includes reliable electronic signatures or authentication techniques.
applicability: Applies to entities using electronic signatures or authentication techniques.
notes: This requirement ensures that only reliable electronic signatures are used, which is a core data protection obligation.

requirement: Electronic records must include details that facilitate the identification of origin, destination, date, and time of despatch or receipt.
checkable_test: Check if the electronic records contain the required details for origin, destination, date, and time of despatch or receipt.
applicability: Applies to entities handling electronic records.
notes: This requirement ensures transparency and traceability of electronic records, which is a core data fiduciary obligation.

requirement: Rules, regulations, orders, bye-laws, notifications, or other matters published in the Official Gazette or Electronic Gazette are deemed to satisfy publication requirements.
checkable_test: Verify if the publication of rules, regulations, etc., in the Official Gazette or Electronic Gazette satisfies the legal requirement for publication.
applicability: Applies to entities required to publish rules, regulations, etc.
notes: This requirement ensures that electronic publication meets legal standards for transparency and accessibility.

requirement: The date of publication of rules, regulations, orders, bye-laws, notifications, or other matters is deemed to be the date of the first publication in any form.
checkable_test: Check if the date of publication is recorded as the date of the first publication in any form.
applicability: Applies to entities publishing rules, regulations, orders, bye-laws, notifications, or other matters.
notes: This requirement ensures consistency in the recording of publication dates, which is important for legal compliance.

requirement: Electronic records must be attributable to the originator, and the originator must be acknowledged as the sender.
checkable_test: Verify if the electronic record includes attribution to the originator and acknowledgment of the sender.
applicability: Applies to entities handling electronic records.
notes: This requirement ensures the authenticity and traceability of electronic records, which is a core data protection obligation.

requirement: The despatch of an electronic record occurs when it enters a computer resource outside the control of the originator, unless otherwise agreed upon.
checkable_test: Check if the despatch timing is defined as the entry into a computer resource outside the originator's control.
applicability: Applicable to all electronic records despatched by the originator.
notes: This clause defines the timing of despatch for electronic records.

requirement: Receipt of an electronic record occurs when it enters the designated computer resource, or when it is retrieved by the addressee if sent to a non-designated resource.
checkable_test: Verify if the receipt timing is defined based on entry into the designated resource or retrieval by the addressee.
applicability: Applicable to all electronic records sent to an addressee.
notes: This clause defines the timing of receipt for electronic records.

requirement: If no designated computer resource is specified, receipt occurs when the electronic record enters the addressee's computer resource.
checkable_test: Check if the receipt timing is defined as the entry into the addressee's computer resource when no designated resource is specified.
applicability: Applicable to all electronic records sent to an addressee without a designated resource.
notes: This clause defines the timing of receipt for electronic records when no designated resource is specified.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must specify the manner in which they shall conduct their dealings with subscribers.
source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities (k)
checkable_test: Check if the Certifying Authority's policies specify the manner of dealings with subscribers.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the regulation of Certifying Authorities and their dealings with subscribers.

requirement: Certifying authorities must maintain procedures and standards specified in section 30.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies that certifying authorities must maintain procedures and standards as specified in section 30.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation of certifying authorities to maintain procedures and standards as specified in section 30.

requirement: Certifying authorities must not reject an application unless the applicant has been given a reasonable opportunity to present their case.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies that applications cannot be rejected without providing the applicant with a reasonable opportunity to present their case.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation of certifying authorities to provide applicants with a fair process.

requirement: Certifying authorities must be the repository of all electronic signature certificates issued under this Act.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies that certifying authorities must act as the repository for all electronic signature certificates issued under this Act.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation of certifying authorities to maintain and store electronic signature certificates.

requirement: Certifying authorities must act in accordance with the procedure specified in their certification practice statement to deal with events or situations that materially and adversely affect the reliability of a certificate or the Authority's ability to perform its services.
checkable_test: Verify that the certifying authority follows procedures outlined in its certification practice statement for handling certificate-related issues.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities issuing digital certificates.
notes: This requirement ensures that certifying authorities follow established procedures for handling certificate-related events.

requirement: Certifying authorities may prescribe different fees for different classes of applicants when prescribing fees under sub-section (2).
checkable_test: Verify that fees for different classes of applicants are prescribed as per the authority's fee structure.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities issuing digital certificates.
notes: This requirement allows for differentiated fee structures based on applicant classes.

requirement: Certifying authorities must observe such other standards as may be specified by regulations.
checkable_test: Verify that certifying authorities comply with any additional standards specified by regulations.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities issuing digital certificates.
notes: This requirement ensures that certifying authorities adhere to regulatory standards beyond basic requirements.

requirement: Certifying authorities must provide a certification practice statement relevant to their operations.
checkable_test: Verify that a certification practice statement is provided and is relevant to the certifying authority's operations.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities issuing digital certificates.
notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the certification process through the provision of a practice statement.

requirement: A Digital Signature Certificate shall not be revoked unless the subscriber has been given an opportunity of being heard in the matter.
checkable_test: Verify that the subscriber is provided with an opportunity to respond before revocation of the Digital Signature Certificate.
applicability: Applicable to Digital Signature Certificate holders.
notes: This clause outlines a procedural requirement for revocation of Digital Signature Certificates, ensuring due process for subscribers.

requirement: A subscriber to a Digital Signature Certificate must not contravene any rules or regulations made under the IT Act 2000, as such contravention may result in a penalty or compensation to the affected person.
checkable_test: Verify whether the document explicitly states that contravention of IT Act 2000 rules or regulations may result in penalties or compensation.
applicability: Applies to entities issuing or managing Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This obligation is tied to the IT Act 2000 and applies to certificate subscribers.

requirement: Intermediaries must define and enforce the meaning of 'transmit' as electronically sending a visual image with the intent that it be viewed by a person or persons.
checkable_test: Check if the platform's policies clearly define 'transmit' as electronically sending a visual image with the intent to be viewed.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation ensures that the term 'transmit' is interpreted in line with the legal definition.

requirement: Intermediaries must not enforce Section 66A of the IT Act 2000, as it has been struck down by the Supreme Court.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform's policies explicitly state that they do not enforce Section 66A of the IT Act 2000.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is tied to the legal invalidation of Section 66A by the Supreme Court.

requirement: Intermediaries must ensure that individuals who commit or conspire to commit cyber terrorism are punishable with imprisonment which may extend to life imprisonment.
checkable_test: Verify if the platform's policies state that they will enforce the legal consequences for cyber terrorism, including life imprisonment.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries subject to the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is tied to the legal provision that mandates severe penalties for cyber terrorism.

requirement: Intermediaries must coordinate response activities for cyber incidents.
checkable_test: Verify if the intermediary has coordination mechanisms in place for responding to cyber incidents.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries who are required to maintain cybersecurity measures.
notes: This obligation is part of the broader cybersecurity incident management requirements under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: A subscriber must generate a key pair and fulfill their duties as outlined in the Electronic Signature Certificate regulations.
checkable_test: Verify if the subscriber's duties include generating a key pair and fulfilling their obligations as per the Electronic Signature Certificate regulations.
applicability: Applicable to subscribers of Electronic Signature Certificates.
notes: This requirement is derived from the duties of subscribers under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: A subscriber must accept the Digital Signature Certificate as issued, ensuring compliance with the associated obligations.
checkable_test: Check if the subscriber's obligations include accepting the Digital Signature Certificate and adhering to its terms.
applicability: Applicable to subscribers of Digital Signature Certificates.
notes: This requirement is derived from the acceptance obligations of subscribers under the IT Act 2000.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must resolve conflicts of interest between themselves and subscribers.
checkable_test: Verify if the document includes procedures for resolving conflicts of interest between Certifying Authorities and their subscribers.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the requirement to resolve conflicts of interest between Certifying Authorities and subscribers.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must lay down duties for their operations.
checkable_test: Check if the document outlines the duties that Certifying Authorities must adhere to in their operations.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the requirement to lay down the duties of Certifying Authorities.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must regulate their activities and supervise the activities of other Certifying Authorities.
checkable_test: Verify if the document includes provisions for the regulation and supervision of Certifying Authorities.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the requirement to regulate and supervise the activities of Certifying Authorities.

requirement: Certifying Authorities must ensure that electronic signatures are issued in a specified form.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the form in which electronic signatures must be issued by Certifying Authorities.
applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This obligation is derived from the requirement to specify the form of electronic signatures.

requirement: Certifying authorities must ensure that subscribers hold a private key capable of creating a digital signature.
checkable_test: Verify that the subscriber's private key is capable of creating a digital signature as per the certificate requirements.
applicability: Applicable to digital signature certificates issued by certifying authorities.
notes: This requirement ensures the integrity and authenticity of digital signatures.

requirement: Certifying authorities must ensure that the subscriber's public and private keys constitute a functioning key pair.
checkable_test: Confirm that the public and private keys form a functioning key pair as required by the certificate standards.
applicability: Applicable to digital signature certificates issued by certifying authorities.
notes: This requirement ensures the cryptographic integrity of digital signatures.

requirement: Certifying authorities must ensure that the Digital Signature Certificate is published or otherwise made available to the subscriber.
checkable_test: Confirm that the Digital Signature Certificate is published or made available to the subscriber.
applicability: Applicable to digital signature certificates issued by certifying authorities.
notes: This requirement ensures that the subscriber has access to the certificate for verification purposes.

requirement: Certifying authorities must ensure that the subscriber holds the private key corresponding to the public key listed in the Digital Signature Certificate.
checkable_test: Verify that the subscriber holds the private key corresponding to the public key in the certificate.
applicability: Applicable to digital signature certificates issued by certifying authorities.
notes: This requirement ensures that the subscriber has control over the private key used for digital signatures.

requirement: Certifying authorities must ensure that their services provide a reasonable level of reliability suited to the intended functions.
checkable_test: Confirm that the services provided by the certifying authority meet the reliability standards for their intended functions.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities under the IT Act 2000.
notes: This requirement ensures that the certifying authority maintains reliable and secure services.

requirement: Certifying authorities must ensure that the electronic signature is compliant with the provisions of the IT Act and related regulations.
checkable_test: Verify that the electronic signature meets the compliance requirements under the IT Act and its regulations.
applicability: Applicable to certifying authorities issuing electronic signatures.
notes: This requirement ensures that electronic signatures are legally valid and secure.
